findings.consequence: The affected payroll or invoice workflow can fail or store an impossible civil date.
findings.expected: Reject the value before persistence, conversion, or workflow execution.
findings.observed: Invalid BS date: 2082-13-01. Year must be 2000-2099, month 1-12, and day must be valid for that month.
findings.remediation: Validate BS year, month, and day against the canonical month-length row at the input boundary.
findings.title: Invalid BS date reaches a business workflow

findings.consequence: Invoices, attendance, due dates, and sorted reports can move by one day.
findings.remediation: Correct the stored AD value and enforce conversion plus round-trip checks before persistence.
findings.title: Stored AD and BS dates identify different civil days

findings.consequence: Transactions can be assigned to the wrong reporting year at the Shrawan boundary.
findings.expected: Use the configured Nepal fiscal-year convention for the audited workflow.
findings.remediation: Resolve fiscal periods through the shared fiscal engine instead of calendar-year logic.
findings.title: Workflow uses the wrong fiscal-year convention

findings.consequence: A repayment or contractual date can appear final before an authoritative calendar is published.
findings.expected: Require an authoritative source or keep the result explicitly review-required.
findings.remediation: Persist source status and block operational finalization until the authoritative release is available.
findings.title: Future date is treated beyond the official source range

findings.consequence: The workflow can skip or include the wrong working day without an auditable reason.
findings.expected: Attach a named source release and institution policy to the decision.
findings.remediation: Require source ID, release ID, and institution profile before holiday adjustment.
findings.title: Holiday policy lacks a supported source

findings.consequence: Automatic execution would bypass the stated control for a sensitive workflow.
findings.expected: Hold final execution until a reviewer accepts the source and policy context.
findings.remediation: Enforce a review-required state and record reviewer identity, decision, and timestamp.
findings.title: Sensitive workflow requires human approval
